snippet.title: Rope-Kun Adventure　Trailer Movie 4
snippet.description:
This is the trailer for the game in development, "Rope-kun Adventure".

ーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーー
Rope-kun, the protagonist, can only manipulate ropes, but with that single skill, he overcomes every obstacle in this unique and charming puzzle-action game!
Carry objects, bounce balls, tie up enemies... the rope's potential has no limits!
Join Rope-kun and conquer the many challenges that await!
ーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーー

Steam：https://store.steampowered.com/app/2919070

Web : https://www.kei26.com
